name: dumbbell straight arm twisting sit up
description: A sit-up with a rotation while holding a dumbbell on straight arms. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell over your chest.
Sit up while keeping your arms straight.
Twist toward one side at the top.
Return to centre and lower slowly.
Keep your feet down and movement controlled.
